name: Eyes On The Things Above
overview: The Scriptures call believers to fix their focus on God and His eternal purposes rather than on worldly or fleshly concerns. This is shown in the lifting of eyes to the heavens (Psalms 123:1) and the command to meditate on God's law day and night for success and wisdom (Joshua 1:8). The contrast between a spiritually minded life that leads to peace and a carnally minded life that leads to death (Romans 8:6) underscores the necessity of setting one's heart on things above. Believers are warned against savoring the things of men rather than the things of God (Matthew 16:23) and are assured that God’s plans for them are of peace and hope (Jeremiah 29:11), encouraging a steadfast gaze upward and onward.
